purpose: Select an unfamiliar public JSON structure from bounded candidates, infer data invariants from observations, detect violations after repeated ingestion, choose a repair from a bounded catalog, and verify on fresh holdout data.
selection_rule: Choose the resource with the highest observed structural score: field count, relational-id fields, SQL-type diversity, and nested-value complexity; ties are deterministic.
invariant_derivation: Infer a unique identity field from observed non-null unique values, preferring conventional id only when it is actually unique in the sample.
Infer required-field invariants only when every observed row contains a non-null value.
Infer boolean-domain invariants only when all observed values are boolean.
Infer a relational/grouping field from non-identity *Id numeric fields when present.
repair_selection_rule: Select repairs from the bounded catalog only when justified by an observed invariant violation or an inferred bounded query need.
verification: derived invariants have no remaining violations
fresh holdout identities are disjoint from training and are present after loading
the previously learned parameterized select_where helper remains correct on the inferred schema
an inferred query index is used when a grouping field exists
